entry_points.title: swamp localized panel holdout
entry_points.question: Does snowy-Hero successor candidate `3d37e24ca4e8b57038724062fe87a370c98ec208d5bc0f1663aeb907e40b50f8` generalize to a fresh balanced swamp holdout?
entry_points.finding: Aggregate exact accuracy was 11/16 (68.8%). Hero had 3 true positives, 8 true negatives, 5 misses, and no false positives. Inventory had 8 true positives, 6 true negatives, 2 false positives, and no misses. The promotion gate failed.

entry_points.title: default-layout geometry on a real holdout
entry_points.question: Can the deterministic default-layout proposal serve as a UI-region detector, or is it only suitable for conservative crop routing?
entry_points.finding: The default geometry matched zero of three verified regions at the preexisting 0.50 threshold.
